heading: About Us
introduction: Nor’easters Track Club brings together competitive women runners ages 35 and up from Greater Boston and Providence.
description:
We founded the Nor’easters Track Club to fill a gap in the New England running community. Many established clubs build their racing calendars around the USATF-NE Road Race Grand Prix, but for competitive women balancing careers, families, and ambitious individual training goals, traveling to a full slate of races isn’t always practical or compatible with their schedules. Likewise, a one-size-fits-all training model where everyone completes the same track workout together on a designated day and time sounds fun in theory but is difficult to execute.



The Nor’easters offer a different model: one that allows like-minded women to train independently, choose races intentionally, and come together to race hard and have fun as a team. We wanted to create an intimate group of fast, competitive masters women who share a love of racing across distances, from pursuing personal bests on the roads to chasing masters records on the track. At our core, we’re a collective of friends who share a passion for running. Our goal is to build a community where we chase big goals and take racing seriously - without taking ourselves too seriously.
